name: Permission item
summary: One thing an app can do with someone's account, with the app's reason, on the Connect page.

when: On the Connect page, one per permission, in a list.

whenNot.text: For the raw technical permissions, which go behind “Technical details”.

anatomy.description: What the app can do, in plain words.

props.name: label
props.description: What the app can do, such as “Post as you”.

props.name: reason
props.description: The app's reason, such as “so your recipes stay yours”.

accessibility.name: Its text.
screenReader: Read as a list item: what the app can do, then “Why:” and the reason.
notes: Put items in an element with role list, or a ul.

guidelines: Say what the app can do in plain words, never the raw permission.
Reasons start with “so”: “so friends recognise you”.

evidence.point: People grant permissions more confidently when each says why it's needed (prototype research).
